function.name: worker_files_list
function.description: List actual files in this isolated task workspace, with relative path and byte size. No parent or other-agent files are available.

function.name: worker_file_read
function.description: Read an actual UTF-8 text file in this isolated workspace. Use the exact relative path from worker_files_list.

function.name: worker_file_write
function.description: Save a UTF-8 result inside this isolated workspace when writing is enabled. The native executor rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, symlinks and read-only tasks.
